paper_title: Tell2Design A Dataset for Language-Guided Floor Plan Generation
caption: Number of floor plans vs. number of rooms per floor plan in the T2D dataset.
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled “#Floor plan vs. #Room per floor plan,” illustrates the distribution of floor plans across different numbers of rooms per floor plan, as presented in the Tell2Design (T2D) dataset. The horizontal axis represents the number of rooms per floor plan, ranging from 4 to 8, with each integer value labeled beneath its corresponding bar. The vertical axis, labeled with numerical values from 0 to 35,000 in increments of 5,000, quantifies the count of floor plans for each room count. Five blue bars are displayed, each corresponding to a room count: the bar for 4 rooms is the shortest, with a value of 254; the bar for 5 rooms has a value of 5,788; the bar for 6 rooms reaches 25,104; the bar for 7 rooms is the tallest at 29,278; and the bar for 8 rooms is 20,364. The bars are arranged in ascending order of room count along the horizontal axis and are not sorted by height. The chart is visually annotated with the word “Restricted” in red text at the top and bottom, and the bars are uniformly colored blue without any additional visual emphasis or grouping.
